research_role: one bounded portability test of the previously observed adverse apparent-demand mechanism

prior_evidence.exact_high_score_result: late_volume_confirmed_demand Top-20 trailed its date control by 0.463 percentage points at h5, with adverse direction in both broad blocks and 4.577 percentage points worse severe-loss incidence
prior_evidence.interpretation: strong apparent late demand may be a selection trap; this experiment tests a down-ranking/avoidance role inside an independently constructed Champion cohort
prior_evidence.not_claimed: the low-score side has not been independently established as standalone long Alpha

fixed_score.raw: same-date mean percentile rank of close_vs_vwap, closing_30m_return, and last_hour_volume_share
daily_controls: same-date percentile rank of causal daily return
same-date percentile rank of completed daily range divided by preclose
same-date percentile rank of causal r20
fixed_score.incremental_score: same-date OLS residual of the raw rank on intercept plus the three fixed daily-control ranks
fixed_score.orientation: lower is preferred because the already observed high side was adverse
fixed_score.decision_at: 15:30 Asia/Shanghai after the exact completed-session minute summary

fixed_selection.universe: the unchanged ten Weekly Industry Diffusion plus Low-MAX names
fixed_selection.rule: choose the three lowest valid late-demand residual scores per weekly date
fixed_selection.insufficient_valid_names: skip the whole cohort when fewer than three scores are valid
fixed_selection.capital: unchanged one-quarter current NAV per cohort, split equally among the three selected names
fixed_selection.execution: accepted T+1, next-legal-open, limits, suspensions, QD-010 corporate actions, and 20 bps per side

sequential_evaluation.validation: 2021-2023 opened only if every generation gate passes
sequential_evaluation.replay: full 2018-2023 executable replay only if every fixed validation gate passes

prohibited: other minute descriptors, window lengths, composites, residual controls, orientations, thresholds, Top-N values, weights, or holds
using invalid or missing minute scores
changing the Champion industry or Low-MAX construction
rescue after generation, validation, or replay
